# skopec.dev

> Personal portfolio of Josef — graphic design, web development, and home lab.

## Pages
- [Home](https://skopec.dev/): Intro, self-hosted services, friends, FAQ, contact

- [Hardware](https://skopec.dev/hardware.html): Desktop, laptop, server, and phone specs
- [Privacy](https://skopec.dev/privacy.html): Short privacy note for this personal site

## Services
Local 10.0.0.x addresses work only on the home network or with Josef’s Tailscale.
- Proxmox: 10.0.0.200:8006
- Jellyfin: https://jelly.skopec.dev · 10.0.0.101:8096
- Navidrome: 10.0.0.103:4533
- Ollama: 10.0.0.106:3000
- SearXNG: 10.0.0.104:8080
- ConvertX: 10.0.0.107:3000
- NAS: 10.0.0.102
- Pi-hole: 10.0.0.100:80
- Joplin: 10.0.0.111:22300
- Immich: 10.0.0.109:2283
- Cloudflare Tunnels: 10.0.0.105 (exposes services outside the LAN)
- Tailscale: 10.0.0.110 (remote access to local-only services)
